findings.title: Repro of G-1: Firestore rules allow writes from read-only dashboard
findings.claim: ∃ r: r.auth.uid == uid ∧ source(r) == dashboard ∧ allow(r, write)
findings.observed: Emulator: owner uid writes users/u1/projects/p1 meta and events/000000 from a plain web client; both assertFails red (Expected request to fail, but it succeeded). Rules cannot tell dashboard from CLI (same uid, no claim) so ADR0003 read-only is unenforced.

findings.title: Repro of G-2: Partial push failure permanently breaks sync due to create-only rules
findings.claim: ∃ push: fails after batch 1 ⇒ headSeq not updated ∧ retry fails on !exists()
findings.observed: Emulator: 450 events committed (crash after batch 1, meta absent), retry pushEvents of 460 from seq 0 -> PERMISSION_DENIED (create on existing doc = update, denied). Fresh pushes of 15/25/120/460 succeed (control). Retry/idempotency lock-out confirmed; syncPush resends from 0 when remote meta absent.

findings.title: Repro of G-3: Guard allows arbitrary code execution via git subcommands
findings.claim: ∃ cmd ∈ {rebase, submodule, fetch, clone}: guard(cmd)=allow ∧ effect(cmd) ∈ Destructive
findings.observed: assessCommandSafety allows git rebase -x/--exec, submodule foreach, bisect run, fetch/clone --upload-pack (all ok:true, no GIT_RULES entry). Claim wording CWE-88/arbitrary exec holds for these; clone -c / fetch are partially covered by -c global rule.

findings.title: Repro of G-4: Tool runner leaks parent environment secrets to child processes
findings.claim: runTool(cmd) passes process.env verbatim when opts.env is omitted
findings.observed: runTool passes process.env when opts.env omitted: child printed SECRET-xyz for GEMINI_API_KEY (violates I16 child-process env).

findings.title: Repro of G-5: Guard bypass via PowerShell array comma separator
findings.observed: Witness is wrong: remove-item with comma target is blocked (ok:false): colon-in-target check rejects file1,C:/Windows, trailing-dot check rejects a.txt,../../x, and remove-item is shell-only so always blocked. Only rm "a,b" is allowed but there comma is a literal filename on POSIX/no-shell. Gemini witness asserting ok===true fails.

findings.title: Repro of G-6: Hash chain verification ignores whitespace and JSON key order changes
findings.claim: ∃ L, L': L ≠ L' ∧ parse(L) == parse(L') ∧ verify(L) == ok ∧ verify(L') == ok
findings.observed: Literal I1 violation: reformatting whitespace or reversing key order of every line still passes verifyLogText (canonicalEventString re-stringifies fixed key order). No exploit: payload/actor/text changes are still caught, unknown extra keys are not retained in parsed events, so content cannot be altered without hash break. Benign canonicalization; severity low. Gemini witness was assert.ok(true).

findings.title: Repro of G-7: Missing pagination in syncPull causes OOM on large projects
findings.claim: getEvents(from, head) fetches all missing events in a single query
findings.observed: getEvents has no limit()/startAfter(); 1200 seeded events returned in one query. Impact bounded: only the owner uid can write the remote, and Firestore doc cap 1MiB; memory growth is real but self-inflicted (no hostile-remote amplification).

findings.title: Repro of G-8: AI quota bypass via race condition in usage increment
findings.claim: ∃ interleaved executions where N concurrent calls increase the counter by < N
findings.observed: 20 concurrent incrementAiUsage calls leave count=1 (read-modify-write with no lock, last write wins); quota can be bypassed by parallel invocations.
findings.invariant: new: Quota enforcement must be sound

findings.title: Repro of G-9: Credential redaction regex bypasses for camelCase and spaces
findings.claim: maskSecrets(text) fails to match camelCase keys or values with spaces
findings.observed: maskSecrets leaks myApiToken=<12-char-fake>, clientSecret = "hunter22hunter", accessToken: <12-char-fake> (camelCase: /bword-boundary prefix pattern needs [_-] separators), and quoted values with spaces ("secret value", "my pass phrase" leak after first space). apiKey: "<12-char-fake>" is masked.

findings.title: Repro of G-10: Bloated CLI due to heavy firebase web SDK dependency
findings.claim: package.json includes full firebase web SDK instead of lightweight clients
findings.observed: Not a defect: witness only asserts pkg.dependencies.firebase exists. firebase is the runtime SDK actually imported (dynamic) by src/cloud/sync.ts; no invariant concerns footprint and the suggested replacement (firebase-admin) is heavier and server-side.
findings.invariant: new: CLI footprint should be minimal
